verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs show Copilot taking natural-language prompts in Agent mode to make multi-file changes. They also show delegating coding tasks and exploring repos in natural language on GitHub.com, and using the official GitHub MCP server to work with repositories, issues and pull requests from Copilot Chat. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and evidence that platform operations beyond repos/issues/PRs/coding tasks (e.g. settings, Actions administration) can be driven in natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The user switches from 'Ask' mode to 'Agent' mode from a dropdown menu, then sends the prompt 'Update the website to allow searching for running races by name.' Copilot analyzes the codebase, then explains the required edits for three files before generating them.
